sloka: देशे देशे कलत्राणि देशे देशे च बान्धवाः ।तं तु देशं न पश्यामि यत्र भ्राता सहोदरः ।। ६.१०२.१३ ।।
transliteration: deśe deśe kalatrāṇi deśe deśe ca bāndhavāḥ ।taṁ tu deśaṁ na paśyāmi yatra bhrātā sahodaraḥ ।। 6.102.13 ।।

translations.english: 'O Hero! Even victory for me will not give joy. What pleasure will one have if he desires to see the moon when he has lost vision?'
